ننغلق (form VII)
# نَنْغَلِقُ (nanḡaliqu) /nan.ɣa.li.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْغَلَقَ (inḡalaqa)
# نَنْغَلِقَ (nanḡaliqa) /nan.ɣa.li.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْغَلَقَ (inḡalaqa)
# نَنْغَلِقْ (nanḡaliq) /nan.ɣa.liq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْغَلَقَ (inḡalaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
